content.stem: 一家银行的客户尽职调查团队经理发现,上个季度有一名高风险客户的活动未按银行内部规定的时间表进行审查.KYC团队经理应该做什么？

options.A: 提交转介，建议报送可疑活动报告(SAR)
options.B: 评估客户身份识别(KYC)审查流程以了解为何审查未按要求进行,并在必要时采取纠正措施
options.C: 联系客户的客户经理,在完成定期的“了解您的客户”审查之前暂停账户访问权限
options.D: 将客户从银行的高风险名单中移除

content.stem_en: The manager of a bank's KYC team discovers that a high-risk customer's activity was not reviewed last quarter as the bank's internal schedule required. What should the KYC team manager do?

options_en.A: Submit a referral to file a suspicious activity report (SAR)
options_en.B: Evaluate the KYC review process to understand why the review did not occur as required and take corrective action as necessary
options_en.C: Contact the customer's relationship manager to suspend account access until the periodic KYC review is completed
options_en.D: Remove the customer from the bank's high-risk list
